name: popnow
description: Plan AI videos in text and get guidance for integrating the PopNow API into your apps. Planning skills write shot lists, Seedance, Kling, Hailuo and Wan prompts, keyframe prompts, ad hook variants, UGC and explainer scripts, style bibles, platform specs, voice-over briefs, prompt fixes and cost estimates. Developer skills guide integration with the official SDKs and webhooks. This plugin does not generate images, video or audio in Claude.
